title: Diagonal Ramsey numbers for wheels
summary: The Ramsey number $\mathrm{R}(G_1,G_2)$ is the smallest integer $N$ such that any red-blue coloring of the edges of the complete graph $K_N$ contains either a red copy of $G_1$ or a blue copy of $G_2$. In 2022, the third author and others gave lower and upper bounds of the Ramsey number $\mathrm{R}(W_n,W_n)$, where $W_n$ is the wheel graph with $n$ vertices. In this paper, we improve their bounds by showing that $3n-2\leq \mathrm{R}(W_n,W_n)\leq 6n-6$ for even $n\geq 8$ and $2n\leq \mathrm{R}(W_n,W_n)\leq \frac{9n-7}{2}$ for odd $n\geq 7$.
